entities.name: 5GMM common procedures
entities.description: Procedures initiated by AMF during registration, including identification, authentication, and security procedures.

entities.name: Registration procedure
entities.description: Procedure for UE registration with the network, including mobility and periodic registration updates.

entities.name: 5GMM authentication procedure
entities.description: Authentication procedure part of 5GMM common procedures.

entities.name: Security mode control procedure
entities.description: Procedure for establishing security context, specified in subclause 5.4.2.

entities.name: REGISTRATION REQUEST message
entities.description: Message sent by UE to initiate registration procedure.

entities.name: 5GS mobile identity IE
entities.description: Information element containing UE identity such as 5G-GUTI.

entities.name: Additional GUTI IE
entities.description: Information element for providing additional GUTI in registration request.

entities.name: 5G-GUTI
entities.description: Globally Unique Temporary Identifier for 5G system.

entities.name: 5GMM-CONNECTED mode
entities.description: 5GMM connection state where UE has an active connection.

entities.name: UE has only an emergency PDU session
entities.description: Condition where UE is limited to emergency services only.

entities.name: Target cell is a shared network cell
entities.description: Condition indicating the target cell is shared between multiple PLMNs.

entities.name: PLMN identity mismatch
entities.description: Condition where PLMN in GUTI differs from selected PLMN of target cell.

relations.description: Registration procedure includes initiation of 5GMM common procedures.
AMF initiates 5GMM common procedures based on information in REGISTRATION REQUEST message.
Condition of UE having only emergency PDU session allows skipping authentication and proceeding to security mode control.
Authentication procedure initiation is guarded by PLMN identity mismatch condition.
Authentication procedure initiation is guarded by target cell being a shared network cell.
Authentication procedure initiation requires UE to be in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode after handover or inter-system change.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message contains 5GS mobile identity IE.
REGISTRATION REQUEST message may contain Additional GUTI IE.
